output_list.reason: The 'stake' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it adds an amount to the stakes mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the event an attacker succeeds in calling the stake function.

The 'unstake' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it subtracts an amount from the stakes mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the event an attacker succeeds in calling the unstake function.

The 'getReward' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it adds a reward to the rewards mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the event an attacker succeeds in calling the getReward function.
